correction_lesson: A team's per-match stat lives in EITHER the home_* column (when it played at home) OR the away_* column (when away) of the wide matches table. Summing only one side undercounts. Union both: SUM of home_<metric> WHERE home_team_id=team plus away_<metric> WHERE away_team_id=team.
description: Team home+away summation pitfall (variant 2): shots then corners, different teams/seasons.

turns.query: How many shots did Manchester City take in total during the 2023-2024 Premier League season?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(v) AS total FROM (SELECT m.home_shots AS v FROM matches m JOIN seasons s ON m.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id JOIN teams t ON m.home_team_id = t.team_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2023-2024' AND t.team_name = 'Manchester City' UNION ALL SELECT m.away_shots AS v FROM matches m JOIN seasons s ON m.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id JOIN teams t ON m.away_team_id = t.team_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2023-2024' AND t.team_name = 'Manchester City') x;

turns.query: How many corners did Arsenal win in total across the 2024-2025 Premier League season?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(v) AS total FROM (SELECT m.home_corners AS v FROM matches m JOIN seasons s ON m.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id JOIN teams t ON m.home_team_id = t.team_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2024-2025' AND t.team_name = 'Arsenal' UNION ALL SELECT m.away_corners AS v FROM matches m JOIN seasons s ON m.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id JOIN teams t ON m.away_team_id = t.team_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2024-2025' AND t.team_name = 'Arsenal') x;
